label: PF Backlog 98
title: Backend: dynamic per-feature sectioned generation (one LLM call per F-x from product-plan.json) + validation gate that fails flat docs
body:
[OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] ARTIFACT MODEL = per-feature files (option 1B).
Stages 1 (design/functional spec) and 1a (product-design-spec) MUST emit ONE FILE PER FEATURE
(e.g. artifacts/1/features/F-1-functional.md, artifacts/1a/features/F-1-design.md) PLUS a per-stage
index, while KEEPING the existing merged <agent>-output.md so the downstream artifact contract does
not break.

decisions.note: Artifact model = per-feature files (option 1B): one file per feature + per-stage index; keep merged <agent>-output.md
